summary.tldr: Repeals annual duty updates on beer, spirits and wine and sets fixed excise rates and penalties under the Excise Act and Excise Act, 2001.
what_it_does: Repeals the annual adjustment rule for duties on beer, malt liquor, spirits and wine.
Sets new duty rates for beer and malt liquor, including separate rates for Canadian beer brewed in Canada.
Sets new duty rates for spirits and wine, using the listed per litre and per hectolitre amounts.
Updates several penalty formulas for offences and contraventions involving spirits and wine.
Applies the new rates and penalties to the 2022 and later taxation years.
summary.background: The bill amends the Excise Act and the Excise Act, 2001. It removes sections that provide for annual adjustments to duties on beer, malt liquor, spirits and wine.
